title: BCA Assay for Protein Quantification
author: Karina L Conkrite
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6n5hdg6

steps.title: Prepare diluted BSA stock
steps.instruction: Dilute the provided 0.2 % BSA 1:2 with lysis buffer to generate the working BSA stock for the standard curve.

steps.title: Label tubes for standards and samples
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes for the eight BSA standards (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 15, 20 µg/mL) and separate tubes for each sample.

steps.title: Prepare BSA standard series
steps.instruction: In each labeled standard tube add the indicated volumes of 0.1 % BSA and lysis buffer to obtain a final volume of 20 µL and the target concentration:

substeps.instruction: 0 µg/mL: 0 µL 0.1 % BSA + 20 µL lysis buffer
2 µg/mL: 2 µL 0.1 % BSA + 18 µL lysis buffer
4 µg/mL: 4 µL 0.1 % BSA + 16 µL lysis buffer
6 µg/mL: 6 µL 0.1 % BSA + 14 µL lysis buffer
8 µg/mL: 8 µL 0.1 % BSA + 12 µL lysis buffer
10 µg/mL: 10 µL 0.1 % BSA + 10 µL lysis buffer
15 µg/mL: 15 µL 0.1 % BSA + 5 µL lysis buffer
20 µg/mL: 20 µL 0.1 % BSA + 0 µL lysis buffer

steps.title: Add diluted BSA to standards
steps.instruction: Add the diluted BSA stock (prepared in step 1) to each standard tube last, just before adding the working reagent, to bring each tube to the final 20 µL volume as defined above.

steps.title: Prepare sample dilutions on ice
steps.instruction: Keep all samples on ice. To each sample tube add 3 µL of the protein sample and 17 µL of lysis buffer, yielding a total volume of 20 µL.

steps.title: Prepare working BCA reagent
steps.instruction: Prepare enough Working Reagent for all standards and samples (1 mL per tube) by mixing 1 mL Reagent A with 20 µL Reagent B for each milliliter, then add an additional 10 % volume to account for pipetting error.

steps.title: Add working reagent to all tubes
steps.instruction: To each standard and each sample tube add 1 mL of the Working Reagent prepared above. Mix each tube thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a 37 °C incubator for 30 minutes to allow color development.

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: After incubation, remove the tubes and allow them to cool to room temperature before reading.

steps.title: Transfer to 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 200 µL from each tube into a well of a clear 96‑well plate (perform in triplicate if desired).

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Read the plate on the GloMax plate reader using the BCA program at 562 nm.

steps.title: Generate standard curve
steps.instruction: Plot the absorbance values of the BSA standards to create a standard curve (Excel, Statmost, or GraphPad). Ensure the R² value is as close to 1 as possible and that all sample readings fall within the curve range; otherwise repeat the assay.

steps.title: Calculate sample protein concentrations
steps.instruction: Use the linear equation (y = mx + b) from the standard curve to determine the protein amount in each sample, then divide the result by 3 (the dilution factor) to obtain the concentration per µL of original sample.
